item.title: Spencer Carbery floats possibility of pulling goalie in overtime amid Capitals’ shootout woes: ‘Do you get more aggressive in overtime?’
item.description: ARLINGTON, VA — The Washington Capitals have yet to win in the shootout this season, losing all four of their games that have gone past overtime. After falling to the Carolina Hurricanes on Thursday night, the Capitals now have a 6-12 record in the shootout since head coach Spencer Carbery joined the team in 2023-24.
